value.signature: fn stored_key (client_key : Input < '_ > , output : Output < '_ >) -> Result < () , Error >

review.body: { if client_key . 0 . len () != 32 || output . 0 . len () != 32 { return Err (Error :: Bound) ; } Digest :: finalize_into (Sha256 :: new_with_prefix (client_key . 0) , output . 0 . try_into () . map_err (| _ | Error :: Bound) ? ,) ; Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The borrowed operations write only caller-owned destinations, Error has no payload, and no result contains private bytes. Inputs remain protected by their caller. For salted_password, mac and stored_key, the host exit labels delimit the host borrows. The host residue disposition is limited to the primitive temporaries named by ROOT::amend:storage:scram-residue; it admits no unnamed temporary or new consumer.
